summary:
Miro is the online whiteboard at miro.com. The yellow mark in the tab is the icon board links show, saved from the host response.

Checked 12 November 2026 against miro.com. HTML came from https://miro.com/ (HTTP 200). Icon link tags: icon → https://framerusercontent.com/images/6FBG66PBxjV2QFaDfIdUi5mi9A.png; icon → https://framerusercontent.com/images/6FBG66PBxjV2QFaDfIdUi5mi9A.png.

A request to the favicon.ico URL https://miro.com/favicon.ico returned png (48×48, 1309 bytes), not an ICO container. Formats that saved: png.

No apple-touch-icon URL was declared, and the well-known apple-touch-icon.png path did not return an image.

Brand colour #ffdd33 comes from the most common non-white pixel in png-128x128-02.png, quantised to 4 bits per channel.

Largest measured bitmap: png-128x128-02.png at 128×128 (png, 1326 bytes) from https://framerusercontent.com/images/6FBG66PBxjV2QFaDfIdUi5mi9A.png.
